title: Wool Pack
description: Wool Pack is a clean and lightweight resource pack that improves Minecraft’s vanilla look.
body:
# 🌊 Wool Resource Pack

Wool Resource Pack is a clean and lightweight resource pack that keeps the vanilla Minecraft style while improving the overall look of the game.

## Features

* Clean textures
* Vanilla-friendly style
* Lightweight
* Looks great with shaders
* Supports multiple versions

## Perfect for

* PvP
* Minigames
* Survival
* Casual gameplay
